tools.name: list_roots
tools.description: List the read/write filesystem root aliases granted to this session. Call first when durable local output is requested.

tools.name: get_conversion_report
tools.description: Retrieve the bounded diagnostics, applied options, fidelity, provenance, and source-asset manifest for a conversion-backed artifact.

tools.name: convert_document
tools.description: Convert plain text, Markdown, bundles, or linked-registry inputs directly into 1-12 immutable DOCX, PPTX, PDF, XLSX, CSV, HTML, EPUB, DBK, MP4, GIF, or Markdown artifacts.

tools.name: create_document_bundle
tools.description: Stage Markdown plus authority-scoped assets as a reusable immutable DBK artifact.

tools.name: save_artifact
tools.description: Materialize an immutable artifact below a configured write root. Creation is no-replace; replacement requires the current SHA-256.

tools.name: inspect_document
tools.description: Inspect bounded semantic structure, block provenance, assets, metadata, theme, and diagnostics when document analysis is requested.

tools.name: compare_documents
tools.description: Compare two supported documents semantically and report text, structure, table, media, metadata, and theme retention.

tools.name: preview_document
tools.description: Render bounded, paginated preview images of a document, deck, sheet, MP4, or GIF for visual review.

tools.name: get_authoring_context
tools.description: Optionally discover target capabilities, safe defaults, themes, transforms, and exact starter annotation examples. Plain Markdown needs no preflight.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List available slide and document template IDs and summaries.

tools.name: describe_template
tools.description: Describe a template's exact annotation syntax and required inputs.

tools.name: recommend_templates
tools.description: Profile a document's content blocks and recommend compatible templates.

tools.name: describe_theme
tools.description: Describe a built-in theme or a custom theme embedded in a document source.

tools.name: infer_theme_from_file
tools.description: Infer reusable theme colors, typography, and optional Office layout information from an existing DOCX, PPTX, or XLSX file.

tools.name: inspect_pptx_layouts
tools.description: Inspect a PPTX's slide size, masters, layouts, usage, and template mapping.

tools.name: apply_inferred_theme
tools.description: Apply an inferred theme and layout set to a document and return a new DBK artifact without mutating the source.

tools.name: list_formats
tools.description: List live import/export format capabilities and supported fidelity per format.

tools.name: list_transform_styles
tools.description: List available content transform style IDs.
